fix: Load the JWT secret from an environment variable or secret manager and rotate the exposed value.
Use a parameterized query such as `WHERE title LIKE $1` with the value `%${q}%` passed in the params array.
Resolve the path, reject it unless it stays inside REPORT_DIR (or use path.basename / sendFile with a root option).
Hash passwords with a salted slow algorithm such as bcrypt, scrypt or argon2 instead of unsalted MD5.
Validate the URL against an allow-list of hosts/schemes and block private, loopback and link-local addresses before fetching.
Add requireAdmin or verify the ticket belongs to req.user before deleting.
Validate format against an allow-list and use execFile with an argument array instead of exec with string interpolation.
